rules.evidence: Each base skill level above ready baseline, once per skill/level. Starting/tutorial levels excluded.
Comparable nonoverlapping complete XP windows >=300000ms. First window per comparability key is baseline, not reward.
Distinct canonical durable verified skill+episode; rename/replay gives no new award.
Each verified mined Runite ore with mining XP and provenance, not inventory gain alone.
Each previously mined provenance unit verified deposited into bank once; withdrawal/redeposit excluded.
Productive ally/sale/conversation/cooperative drop party needs independently confirmed outcome; text claim insufficient.
Completed player trade, server transaction identity.
Confirmed join after in-person meeting+gift and later private message from that confirmed friend.
Confirmed clan meeting identity/participation, not chat claim.
Confirmed own enemy kill in Wilderness.
Confirmed clanmate enemy kill.
Proven looting from confirmed PvP kill.
Proven escape with that same provenance loot.
Three distinct own confirmed kills without death in one confirmed life; conservatively awarded once on reaching3. Longer-streak eligibility unresolved.
Successful trip with confirmed own/clan enemy kill; base50 plus10 per verified participating clan member.
Per participating clan member in successful confirmed clan PK trip.
Confirmed death only; disconnect is not death.
Comparable proven gameplay speed improvement.
Verified greatest current gameplay weakness improved; unsupported rankings pending.
Comparable reduction in proven unnecessary eligible idle, not visible-idle counters alone.
Comparable proven reduction of idle between decisions, with uncertainty retained.
Comparable proven inventory management improvement.
Proven monitoring improvement only with gameplay experience not reduced.
Each positively proven unnecessary idle tick while actually able to act; lag/travel/animation/cooldown/agreed stops excluded. Missing/helper uncertainty never penalized.

eligibilityNotes: Ambiguous social/clan/PvP/improvement eligibility is pending until a trusted verifier supplies complete structured proof. Model text and score_claim never award points.

Only baseLevel changes score; temporary boosts do not. XP comparisons require same skill/world/XP-rate regime, complete reset-free coverage and non-overlapping >=5min windows. Starting levels, tools and methods are context, not separate record baselines; credible progression or method improvement may earn100. Complete windows are restarted when their active method/equipment changes, then compared with the existing same-skill record.
PK participants must be clan members confirmed in trip evidence, each counted once; base and participant awards are separate exact user amounts.
Improvement facts require comparable genuine before/after metric evidence; only monitoring additionally requires gameplay experience not reduced. No automatic award from scheduler counters.
Unclear ordinal/eligibility interpretations stay pending, not silently awarded.
Three-kill streak is conservatively awarded once upon reaching three distinct own kills in a confirmed life; no extra awards for a longer streak without explicit eligibility clarification.

checkpoints.basis: Cumulative positive proven awards since this fresh ready baseline; deductions affect net score, not checkpoint high-water. Each threshold has a durable identity; reports are batched and explicit ack prevents presentation as new after restart.
